description: This file defines a SwiftUI View named `CronJobEditor`, which provides a user interface for creating and editing scheduled cron jobs within the OpenClaw app on macOS. It includes UI elements for configuring the job's basic info, schedule, payload, and delivery options, supporting different scheduling kinds like 'at', 'every', and 'cron', as well as payload types such as system event and agent turn.

classes.name: CronJobEditor
classes.description: A SwiftUI view component that allows users to create or edit a scheduled cron job, including configuration of schedule timing, payload details, and delivery options.

methods.name: hydrateFromJob
methods.description: Initializes the view's state based on the provided `job` object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates user input and triggers the `onSave` callback with the configured job parameters.

methods.name: gridLabel
methods.description: Helper method to create a label for grid layout within the form.
